iso14001_clauses.title: Scope
iso14001_clauses.summary: This International Standard specifies requirements for an environmental management system that an organization can use to enhance its environmental performance. It is intended for use by an organization seeking to manage its environmental responsibilities in a systematic manner that contributes to the environmental pillar of sustainability.
requirements: Specifies requirements for an environmental management system
Applicable to any organization regardless of size, type, and nature
Can be used to enhance environmental performance
Helps fulfill compliance obligations
Addresses achievement of environmental objectives

iso14001_clauses.title: Normative references
iso14001_clauses.summary: There are no normative references in this document.

iso14001_clauses.title: Terms and definitions
iso14001_clauses.summary: For the purposes of this document, the terms and definitions given in ISO 14001:2015 apply. Key terms include: environmental policy, environmental aspect, environmental condition, environmental impact, environmental objective, compliance obligations, risk, etc.
requirements: Refer to ISO 14001:2015 for complete list of terms and definitions

iso14001_clauses.title: Context of the organization
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of the environmental management system (EMS). It must also identify interested parties and their requirements, define the scope of the EMS, and establish the EMS accordingly.
requirements: Determine external and internal issues relevant to EMS
Include climate change as a relevant external issue (AMD.1:2024)
Identify interested parties and their needs and expectations
Consider whether climate change is a relevant interested party requirement (AMD.1:2024)
Define scope of EMS considering issues and interested parties
Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve EMS

iso14001_clauses.title: Understanding the organization and its context
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine external and internal issues that are relevant to its purpose and that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of its environmental management system. (AMD.1:2024 adds that the organization shall determine whether climate change is a relevant issue.)
requirements: Determine external issues (environmental conditions, legal, technological, competitive, market, cultural, social, economic)
Determine internal issues (values, culture, knowledge, environmental performance)
Monitor and review information about these issues
Consider climate change as a relevant external issue (AMD.1:2024)

iso14001_clauses.title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the interested parties that are relevant to the environmental management system, and the relevant needs and expectations (i.e., requirements) of these interested parties. (AMD.1:2024 adds a note that relevant interested parties can have requirements related to climate change.)
requirements: Identify interested parties relevant to EMS
Determine their needs and expectations (compliance obligations)
Monitor and review information about interested parties and their requirements
Note: Climate change-related requirements may arise from interested parties (AMD.1:2024)

iso14001_clauses.title: Determining the scope of the environmental management system
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the boundaries and applicability of the EMS to establish its scope. The scope shall be documented and consider external and internal issues, interested party requirements, and organizational units, functions, and physical boundaries.
requirements: Consider issues from 4.1 and requirements from 4.2
Consider organizational units, functions, and physical boundaries
Define boundaries and applicability
Document the scope and make it available
Include activities, products, and services within scope

iso14001_clauses.title: Environmental management system
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve an environmental management system, including the processes needed and their interactions, in accordance with the requirements of ISO 14001.
requirements: Establish, implement, maintain, and continually improve EMS
Include processes needed and their interactions

iso14001_clauses.title: Leadership
iso14001_clauses.summary: Top management must demonstrate leadership and commitment, establish an environmental policy, and ensure roles, responsibilities, and authorities are assigned and communicated.
requirements: Demonstrate leadership and commitment
Establish, implement, and maintain environmental policy
Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities

iso14001_clauses.title: Leadership and commitment
iso14001_clauses.summary: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment by taking accountability for EMS effectiveness, ensuring policy and objectives are established, integrating EMS into business processes, promoting continual improvement, providing resources, and communicating the importance of effective environmental management.

Ensure environmental policy and objectives are established
Integrate EMS requirements into business processes
Promote use of process approach and continual improvement
Ensure resources are available
Communicate importance of effective environmental management
Ensure EMS achieves intended outcomes
Engage, direct, and support persons
Support other relevant management roles

iso14001_clauses.title: Environmental policy
iso14001_clauses.summary: Top management shall establish, implement, and maintain an environmental policy that is appropriate to the organization's purpose and context, including the nature, scale, and environmental impacts of its activities, products, and services. It shall provide a framework for setting environmental objectives, include commitments to protect the environment, fulfill compliance obligations, and continual improvement. The policy must be documented, communicated, and available to interested parties.
requirements: Establish environmental policy appropriate to purpose, context, and environmental impacts
Provide framework for setting environmental objectives
Include commitment to protect the environment (including pollution prevention and other specific commitments)
Include commitment to fulfill compliance obligations
Include commitment to continual improvement
Be maintained as documented information
Be communicated within organization
Be available to interested parties

iso14001_clauses.title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
iso14001_clauses.summary: Top management shall ensure that the responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles are assigned, communicated, and understood within the organization. It shall assign responsibility and authority for ensuring EMS conformity and reporting on EMS performance.
requirements: Assign responsibilities and authorities for relevant roles
Communicate responsibilities and authorities
Ensure they are understood
Assign specific responsibility for EMS conformity to ISO 14001 requirements
Assign responsibility for reporting on EMS performance to top management

iso14001_clauses.title: Planning
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall take actions to address risks and opportunities, determine environmental aspects and compliance obligations, plan actions, and establish environmental objectives and plans to achieve them.
requirements: Address risks and opportunities related to EMS
Determine environmental aspects and compliance obligations
Plan actions to address them
Establish environmental objectives and plans

iso14001_clauses.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish processes to determine risks and opportunities related to its environmental aspects, compliance obligations, and other issues that need to be addressed to give assurance the EMS can achieve its intended outcomes, prevent or reduce undesired effects, and achieve continual improvement.
requirements: Establish processes to determine risks and opportunities
Consider environmental aspects (6.1.2) and compliance obligations (6.1.3)
Determine risks and opportunities related to EMS
Plan actions to address them
Integrate and implement actions into EMS processes
Evaluate effectiveness of actions

iso14001_clauses.title: Environmental aspects
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the environmental aspects of its activities, products, and services that it can control and influence, and their associated environmental impacts, considering a life cycle perspective. It shall determine those aspects that have or can have a significant environmental impact (significant environmental aspects) and communicate them.
requirements: Determine environmental aspects of activities, products, services
Consider control and influence
Consider a life cycle perspective
Determine associated environmental impacts
Determine significant environmental aspects
Communicate significant environmental aspects among relevant levels and functions
Maintain documented information of environmental aspects and impacts

iso14001_clauses.title: Compliance obligations
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine and have access to the compliance obligations related to its environmental aspects. It shall then determine how these compliance obligations apply to the organization and take them into account when establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving its EMS.
requirements: Determine compliance obligations related to environmental aspects
Have access to compliance obligations
Determine how they apply
Take them into account in EMS

iso14001_clauses.title: Planning action
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall plan actions to address its significant environmental aspects, compliance obligations, and risks and opportunities, and to integrate and implement these actions into its EMS processes. It shall also plan how to evaluate the effectiveness of these actions.
requirements: Plan actions to address significant environmental aspects
Plan actions to address compliance obligations
Plan actions to address risks and opportunities
Integrate actions into EMS processes
Evaluate effectiveness of actions

iso14001_clauses.title: Environmental objectives and planning to achieve them
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish environmental objectives at relevant functions and levels, considering its significant environmental aspects, compliance obligations, and risks and opportunities. Objectives shall be consistent with environmental policy, measurable, monitored, communicated, and updated. Plans for achieving them shall determine what will be done, resources, responsibilities, timing, and how results will be evaluated.
requirements: Establish environmental objectives for relevant functions and levels
Consider significant environmental aspects and compliance obligations
Consider risks and opportunities
Be consistent with environmental policy
Be measurable (if practicable)
Be monitored
Be communicated
Be updated as appropriate
Maintain documented information on objectives
Determine what will be done
Determine resources required

iso14001_clauses.title: Support
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine and provide resources needed for the EMS, ensure persons are competent, establish awareness, determine communication, and control documented information.
requirements: Provide resources
Ensure competence of persons
Establish awareness
Determine internal and external communication
Control documented information

iso14001_clauses.title: Resources
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance, and continual improvement of the EMS.
requirements: Determine resources needed for EMS
Provide resources

iso14001_clauses.title: Competence
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine the necessary competence of persons doing work under its control that affects its environmental performance and ability to fulfill its compliance obligations. It shall ensure these persons are competent on the basis of education, training, or experience. Where applicable, take actions to acquire necessary competence and evaluate effectiveness. Retain documented information as evidence.
requirements: Determine necessary competence of persons affecting environmental performance
Ensure persons are competent based on education, training, or experience
Take actions to acquire necessary competence
Evaluate effectiveness of actions
Retain documented information as evidence of competence

iso14001_clauses.title: Awareness
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall ensure that persons doing work under its control are aware of the environmental policy, relevant environmental aspects and actual or potential impacts, their contribution to EMS effectiveness, and implications of not conforming to EMS requirements.
requirements: Ensure awareness of environmental policy
Ensure awareness of relevant environmental aspects and impacts
Ensure awareness of contribution to EMS effectiveness
Ensure awareness of implications of not conforming

iso14001_clauses.title: Communication
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish processes for internal and external communication relevant to the EMS, including what, when, with whom, how, and who communicates. It shall consider compliance obligations and ensure that communicated information is consistent and reliable.

Establish processes for external communication
Determine what to communicate
Determine when to communicate

Determine how to communicate
Ensure information is consistent and reliable

iso14001_clauses.title: Documented information
iso14001_clauses.summary: The EMS shall include documented information required by ISO 14001 and determined by the organization as necessary for effectiveness. Creation, update, and control of documented information must be managed to ensure availability and protection.

Include documented information determined necessary for EMS effectiveness
Ensure appropriate identification and description
Ensure appropriate format and media
Ensure review and approval for suitability and adequacy

iso14001_clauses.title: Operation
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization must plan, implement, and control processes needed to meet EMS requirements, including operational planning and control, and emergency preparedness and response.
requirements: Plan, implement, and control operational processes
Establish operational criteria
Control processes per criteria
Manage planned changes
Control outsourced processes
Establish emergency preparedness and response

iso14001_clauses.title: Operational planning and control
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, control, and maintain processes needed to meet EMS requirements and implement actions determined in Clause 6, by establishing operating criteria and controlling processes in accordance with criteria. It shall control planned changes and review consequences of unintended changes. It shall ensure outsourced processes are controlled.

Establish operating criteria

iso14001_clauses.title: Emergency preparedness and response
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain processes needed to prepare for and respond to potential emergency situations. It shall take action to prevent or mitigate environmental impacts from emergencies, periodically test response procedures, review and revise processes after incidents, and provide information and training.

Plan actions to prevent or mitigate environmental impacts
Respond to actual emergency situations
Take action to mitigate consequences

iso14001_clauses.title: Performance evaluation
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization must monitor, measure, analyze, and evaluate its environmental performance, evaluate compliance, conduct internal audits, and perform management reviews.

Evaluate compliance with obligations
Conduct internal audits

iso14001_clauses.title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall determine what needs to be monitored and measured, methods, criteria, and when to analyze and evaluate results. It shall ensure calibrated or verified monitoring and measurement equipment. It shall evaluate its environmental performance and effectiveness of EMS. It shall retain documented information as evidence.

Determine methods for monitoring, measurement, analysis, and evaluation
Determine criteria against which to evaluate environmental performance

iso14001_clauses.title: Evaluation of compliance
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall establish, implement, and maintain processes for evaluating fulfillment of its compliance obligations. It shall determine frequency of compliance evaluation, take action if needed, maintain knowledge of compliance status, and retain documented information.

Determine frequency of compliance evaluation

iso14001_clauses.title: Internal audit
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on whether the EMS conforms to the organization's own requirements and ISO 14001, and is effectively implemented and maintained. It shall establish an audit programme, define audit criteria and scope, select auditors, and report results.

Determine if EMS conforms to organization's requirements and ISO 14001

iso14001_clauses.title: Management review
iso14001_clauses.summary: Top management shall review the EMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness. The review shall consider status of previous actions, changes in context and interested parties, environmental performance, compliance status, audit results, resources, and opportunities for improvement. (AMD.1:2024 adds that the organization shall consider climate change as part of changes in external and internal issues.)

Ensure continuing suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness

iso14001_clauses.title: Improvement
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization must determine opportunities for improvement, react to nonconformities, take corrective action, and continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the EMS.

React to nonconformities and take corrective action

iso14001_clauses.title: Nonconformity and corrective action
iso14001_clauses.summary: When a nonconformity occurs, the organization shall react, take action to control and correct it, deal with consequences, evaluate need for action to eliminate causes, implement any action needed, review effectiveness of corrective action, make changes to EMS if necessary, and retain documented information.

iso14001_clauses.title: Continual improvement
iso14001_clauses.summary: The organization shall continually improve the suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of the EMS to enhance environmental performance.
requirements: Continually improve suitability, adequacy, and effectiveness of EMS
Enhance environmental performance
